Stay · Bodh Gaya, India

Rest close to the Mahabodhi.

★★★★★4.8 / 5

Marasa Sarovar Premiere Hotel, Bodhgaya

Luxury 5-Star Sanctuary

Inspired by timeless Buddhist architecture and the sacred Mahabodhi Temple, this serene riverside retreat along the Falgu River blends spiritual tranquility with modern luxury. Unwind beside peaceful lotus ponds, rejuvenate at the full-service spa, take a dip in the outdoor pool, or savor wholesome meals at Varada Café, an all-day vegetarian dining experience.

Starting from LKR 16,909 – 18,867 / night

Book on WhatsApp
★★★★★4.7 / 5

Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Bodh Gaya

Expansive 5-Star Retreat

Nestled across 18 acres of lush, peaceful gardens just minutes from the Mahabodhi Temple, Welcomhotel offers an elevated sanctuary for spiritual travelers and pilgrimage groups. Enjoy spacious, contemporary rooms, a refreshing outdoor swimming pool, a modern fitness center, and refined on-site dining crafted for comfort and relaxation.

Starting from LKR 48,540 / night

★★★★☆4.6 / 5

Hyatt Place Bodh Gaya

Contemporary 4-Star Comfort

Overlooking scenic green paddy fields near the revered Mahabodhi Stupa, Hyatt Place pairs modern convenience with a calm, restorative atmosphere. Guests enjoy spacious accommodations, complimentary breakfast, a relaxing spa and fitness center, and thoughtful, dedicated assistance tailored to pilgrims.
